```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>", eval = FALSE)
library(ProcessBatchATB)
```

## Overview

`ProcessBatchATB` processes batch fermentation (BMP) assay data following
VDI 4630. Analytics (substrate characterisation, inoculum) are processed
via `ProcessLabAssistant` under the hood — users of this package only ever
call `ProcessBatchATB` functions directly.

## Pipeline

| Step | Function | Description |
|------|----------|-------------|
| 1 | `import_analytik_batch()` | Analytics export files |
| 2 | `import_samples()` | Sample protocol sheet |
| 3 | `import_gaswerte()` | Gas measurement sheets (w1–w6) |
| 4 | `process_analytik()` | Clean/transform analytics, compute inoculum blank mean |
| 5 | `calc_gasvol()` | Normalised volumes, blank correction, cumulative sums |
| 6 | `calc_daily()` | Daily aggregation, day counter |
| 7 | `calc_termination()` | VDI 4630 stop criterion |
| 8 | `calc_yields()` | Biogas and methane yields per ODM |
| 9 | `check_validity()` | Pairwise replicate deviation |

## Quick start

```{r pipeline}
library(ProcessBatchATB)

results <- run_batch_pipeline(
  protokoll_path = "data/Protokoll_VersuchXY.xlsx",
  analytik_path  = "data/Analysen",
  bad_channels   = c()   # e.g. c("W1P3") to exclude a faulty position
)

results$yields      # daily biogas + methane yields per ODM
results$validity    # pairwise replicate deviations (VDI 4630)
results$termination # which days are valid per variant
```

## Step-by-step

```{r step-by-step}
# 1. Import
raw      <- import_analytik_batch("data/Analysen")
samples  <- import_samples("data/Protokoll.xlsx")
gaswerte <- import_gaswerte("data/Protokoll.xlsx")

# 2. Process analytics
result <- process_analytik(raw, samples)
# result$analytik  -- cleaned/transformed analytics + inoculum blank mean
# result$proben    -- sample table with TS values and ODM weighings joined

# 3. Gas calculations
df_gas   <- calc_gasvol(gaswerte, result$proben)
df_daily <- calc_daily(df_gas)

# 4. Termination + yields
df_term   <- calc_termination(df_gas, df_daily)
df_yields <- calc_yields(df_daily, df_term)
df_valid  <- check_validity(df_yields, result$proben)
```

## Termination criterion (VDI 4630)

A variant is considered complete when the daily specific biogas production
rate falls to **≤ 0.5% of cumulative production per day** for three
consecutive days, with this condition only evaluated after **day 25**.

## Normalisation

Gas volumes are corrected for temperature and pressure deviations from
standard conditions (0 °C, 1013.25 hPa) using:

$$
f_{norm} = \frac{(p - p_{H_2O}) \times 273.15}{1013.25 \times (273.15 + T)}
$$

where $p_{H_2O} = -4.3965 + 9.7962 \times e^{0.0521 \times T}$.

## Relationship to ProcessLabAssistant

`ProcessBatchATB` depends on `ProcessLabAssistant` for the analytics
cleaning and transformation logic, but this is handled internally —
users only call `ProcessBatchATB` functions:

```
ProcessBatchATB                      ProcessLabAssistant (internal)
───────────────────────────          ──────────────────────────────
import_analytik_batch()   ────────►  import_analytik()
process_analytik()        ────────►  clean_analytik()
                                     transform_analytik()
calc_gasvol()
calc_daily()
calc_termination()
calc_yields()
check_validity()
```
